headline: Hormuz me teen tanker mine se aag
detail: Iran ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me teen tel tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me ghire; Iran ka daava hai jahaz pratibandhit kshetra me the, swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui.
exam_angle: Hormuz: vishwa tel vyapar ka mahatvapurna jaladmarumadhya.

headline: Jeffries pehle Black Speaker ke ummidvar
detail: House Democrats ne band matdan me 251-11 se Hakeem Jeffries ko Speaker pad ke liye namankit kiya; 3 January ko poore House me matdan hoga, jeetne par ve pehle Black Speaker banenge.
exam_angle: America ke House Speaker: rashtrapati uttaradhikar me teesra sthan.
image_credit: Office of Representative Hakeem Jeffries, Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

headline: 2035 tak Islam sabse bada dharm
detail: Pew Research ke anuman ke mutabik 2035 tak Musalman aabadi 2.57 arab hokar Isaiyon (2.52 arab) se aage nikal jayegi; unchi janm dar is badlav ki mukhya vajah hai.
exam_angle: Pew Global Religious Futures: jansankhya aur dharm ka adhyayan.

headline: Israel ka Gaza me naya bhumi abhiyan
detail: Israel ne October 2025 yuddhaviram ke baad pehli baar madhya Gaza me Yellow Line ke paschim me bhumi karvai shuru ki; Bureij-Nuseirat ke logon ko ilaka khali karne ko kaha gaya.
exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram (Oct 2025) aur Board of Peace ki bhoomika.

headline: Bangladesh ka pehla parmanu sanyantra grid se juda
detail: Bangladesh ke Rooppur parmanu sanyantra ki pehli ikai ne 17 November ko parikshan ke roop me 350 MW bijli rashtriya grid ko di; poori kshamata 1,200 MW hai aur vanijyik utpadan 10 mahine ke parikshan ke baad shuru hoga.
exam_angle: Bangladesh ka pehla parmanu sanyantra; Russia ki Rosatom ne banaya.
